list.title: Campaigns
list.emptyDescription: Create your first campaign to start routing traffic.

form.detailsDescription: Name, source, and where traffic lands if no rule matches.
form.sourceEmpty: No traffic sources yet — creating one isn't built yet, so a campaign needs at least one to exist already.
form.fallbackUrlHint: Used when no stream set matches (Phase 7 builds the rules that route around this).
form.externalCampaignIdHint: The ad platform's own campaign ID — set this to match this campaign against synced Facebook/TikTok spend.
form.archivedNotice: This campaign is archived — changes aren't available. Duplicate it to keep working with these settings.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters

trackingLinks.title: Tracking Links
trackingLinks.description: The URL you send traffic to — resolves through this campaign's stream sets and flows.
trackingLinks.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
trackingLinks.archivedNotice: This campaign is archived and doesn't route traffic — creating or changing links isn't available.
trackingLinks.noDomainsDescription: Park a domain before creating a tracking link for this campaign.
trackingLinks.emptyDescription: Create one above to get a URL to send traffic to.
trackingLinks.insecure: The domain has no valid SSL certificate yet, so this link is http. Facebook and TikTok need https: open the domain to check SSL.
trackingLinks.deleteConfirmDescription: Traffic already sent to this URL will stop resolving. This cannot be undone.

builder.title: Link builder
builder.description: utm_* and sub1–sub10 are appended to the link. The platform's macros ({{macros}}) are kept as-is — the platform fills them in itself.

newCampaign.title: New Campaign
newCampaign.trackingLinksLockedDescription: Fill in and save the campaign details on the left — you'll be able to create tracking links here once it exists.
newCampaign.streamSetsLockedDescription: Fill in and save the campaign details on the left — you'll be able to add stream sets here once it exists.

rowActions.archiveConfirmDescription: Archived campaigns stop routing traffic, are hidden from the active list, and can no longer be edited. Duplicate the campaign to keep working with these settings.
